comment: The PITCH CV is scaled as the voltage divided by ten minus five before the attenuator, so at 0V it shifts the reading speed a long way negative; that looks like a mistake in the code rather than a designed range, and the line avoids quoting a figure. Param 12 (SPAWN_THROTTLING_KNOB) is declared but has no control on the panel. Input 5 (CONTOUR) and param 12 have no jack or control on the panel and are not read. PAN's range depends on the PAN switch: set to unipolar the code divides the voltage by 5 and subtracts 1, so 0 to 10V covers hard left to hard right; set to bipolar it divides by 10, so ±10V covers the same span. No range is written for that jack because it is not fixed.
